rules.statement: A party cannot claim ownership of land that has been vested in the Land Reform Commission under the Land Reform Law.
rules.supporting_quote: By the time the plaintiff gave evidence before the District Court on 14.12.1972 and when the District Judge pronounced the Judgment on 24.01.1973, the land had been vested in the Land Reform Commission by operation of law, i.e. by operation of section 3 of the Land Reform Law, No. 1 of 1972, which came into operation on 26.08.1972.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 3 of the Land Reform Law, No. 1 of 1972
